posts.author: juliankaryu
posts.body:
I had an idea for my project and I need masks for a group of characters, so I thought about using Japanese masks like the ones from the Japanese Character Generator Expansion 3 DLC, but I saw that it is for RPG Maker MV, does anyone know if there is a version for MZ or if it would be possible to use the same resources?
link from the dlc:

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
I mean if the style suits you, I'm pretty sure the MZ generator functions the exact same as the MV one does, so you could still grab this.
edit: I was informed that you can't actually buy DLC for an engine you don't own (weird), but you can pick up the pack on the komodo plaza too:
https://plaza-us.komodo.jp/products/japanese-ch-gen-expansion-1
Other issues that may arise is that you may or may not make some small adjustments to the images to fit right in the generator, and perhaps do some editing to blend it right since the MZ RTP is a little different. I'm fairly sure I've seen
@Avery
post about doing that somehwere...

posts.author: juliankaryu
posts.body: Thanks for the tip. I'm going to do this test and hope to get the edits right, although I'll have to edit something anyway because the idea is to have 7 different masks
